'''''Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published quarterly by [[Springer Science+Business Media]]. Established in 1999,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Galdi |first1=Giovanni P. |last2=Heywood |first2=John G. |last3=Rannacher |first3=Rolf |title=Editorial |date=1999 |journal=Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics |volume=1 |issue=1 |page=1-3 |doi=10.1007/s000210050001}}</ref> it covers mathematical theory of [[fluid dynamics]] with a focus on [[Navier–Stokes equations]].<ref name="aims-scope">{{cite web |title=Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics: Aims and Scope |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/21/aims-and-scope |website=springer.com |access-date=August 17, 2026}}</ref> Its current [[editor-in-chief]] is [[Giovanni Paolo Galdi]] ([[University of Pittsburgh]]).<ref name="editorial">{{cite web |title= Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics: Editorial Board |url=https://link.springer.com/journal/21/editorial-board |website=springer.com |access-date=August 17, 2026}}</ref>
